statement: A secret the DeltaTransformer logs (`SecretRevealed(hashlock indexed, secret)`, emitted by `revealSecret`, which anyone may call, with no Depository log and no dispute) is a chain fact exactly as the Depository's is: the watcher decodes the transformer's log (an address of the deployment's `Deployed` event), tells every hosted Entity `j_secret` with the block it was shown in, and an Entity that forwarded a lock under that hashlock claims upstream at depth. The log of any other address stays foreign, and a log of the transformer that is not its reveal or not shaped as one is a fault.
source: coordinator relay 10-03 01:55 (reveal PR: watch DeltaTransformer SecretRevealed at depth); builder; consolidation-plan.md D9

layers.arrival: n/a: the Arrival specs take J events as given
layers.quint: n/a: the Quint model takes a revealed secret as a J event, whichever contract logged it
layers.contract: n/a: the contract is pinned; the node reads what DeltaTransformer.revealSecret already logs
layers.rig: owed: test rig (a walk predicate for this rule; none is named yet)

killers.name: R-REVEAL-DIRECT a secret shown with no dispute at all is passed up: the hub claims the lock
R-REVEAL-DIRECT a secret shown to the transformer alone reaches the Entity with its block
R-REVEAL-DIRECT the transformer's own reveal, by anyone, is a shown secret with no revealer
R-REVEAL-DIRECT a log of the transformer that is not its reveal, or not shaped as one, is a fault
R-REVEAL-DIRECT a log from an address that is neither the Depository nor the transformer is foreign
